name: omp-multi-agent
description: Multi-agent, multi-model team for oh-my-pi: interview-driven planning, critic review, category-routed parallel execution with review gates and continuation.
author: RieGan <ganjarparikesit@gmail.com>

omp.name: omp-multi-agent
omp.description: Planner → critic → conductor team with per-role models across providers.

disabledProviders.description: Comma-separated provider ids the team must never route to (e.g. "synthetic"). Applies to team agents and the planner.

reviewPolicy.description: risk-based: quick tasks skip per-task review; always: every task is reviewed.

commitPolicy.description: per-task: conductor commits each verified plan task; none: leave changes uncommitted.

maxStalledNudges.description: Plan-execution continuation stops after this many consecutive nudges without a newly checked task.

plannerSwitchModel.description: Switch the main session to the planner model during /team-plan and restore it afterwards.
